sections.title: Ceramics as a vocation
sections.content: The definition and history of ceramics, career opportunities, types of products e.g. bricks, tiles, vases, bowls, their uses i.e. utilitarian and decorative, relation of products to the culture of the people. Indigenous pottery e.g. Ntonso, Pankrono pottery etc. Ghanaian pioneer contemporary ceramic artists e.g. Daniel Cobblah, W.C. Owusu, R.C. Ekem, Ofori Duodu, K.K. Broni, J.K. Amoah, Kofi Asante, J.K. Nsiah, I.K. Oteng, P.S. Kwawukume, David Tetteh, Adu Darko, A.E. Quarm, Happy Kufeh, etc.

sections.title: Raw materials (Clay, Glazes and Other Raw Materials)

subsections.title: Clay
subsections.content: The definition of clay, its formation, kinds and types of clay e.g. primary clay e.g. kaolin, secondary clay e.g. Ball clay, earthenware clay, stoneware, etc. Prospecting and tests for clays, plasticity, shrinkage, firing temperature etc. Preparation of clay, types of clay bodies e.g. plastic, rough etc. Sources of raw materials.

subsections.title: Tools
subsections.content: Their uses and maintenance e.g. Modelling and trimming tools, sponge, cutting wire, callipers, knives, scraper, kidney, dipper, etc.

subsections.title: Equipment
subsections.content: Their uses and maintenance e.g. Kilns, kiln furniture, potters wheel, blunger, pug mill, jaw crusher, filter press, ball mill, dehumidifier, spraying booth, spraying machine, sackboard, etc.

subsections.title: Design and construction
subsections.content: Modelling tools, cutting wire, dipper, sackboard, rolling pin, kiln design and construction.

subsections.title: Drawing and designing
subsections.content: Idea development e.g. sketching, drawing, dimensioning, planning, computer aided designing etc.

subsections.title: Hand building
subsections.content: e.g. Pinching, coiling, slab building, etc. Wheel work e.g. Throwing, Turning.

subsections.title: Decorative processes
subsections.content: e.g. Stamping, Inlaying, Incision, Embossing, Sgraffito, Slip Trailing, Glazing, Sprigging, Spraying, Painting, Printing, etc.

subsections.title: Drying and firing
subsections.content: Open firing, kiln firing (Bisque firing), Glost firing.

subsections.title: Glazing
subsections.content: Preparation, Application, Firing, and its defects.

subsections.title: Factors
subsections.content: Site finding, financing, branding, registration, licensing, labour, quality control.

subsections.title: Costing, pricing, packaging, and marketing
subsections.content: Market surveying, valuing, labour cost, transportation, etc.

sections.title: Exhibition
sections.content: Definition, types, planning and organizing exhibitions.

sections.title: Ceramic production and sustainable environmental issues
sections.content: Energy conservation, afforestation, land reclamation, etc.

sections.title: Professional Practices/Ethics
sections.content: Healthy studio practices, Building a portfolio of works, Developing Business Plan, Brochure and Business card, Portfolio Development, Sustainable environment.

sections.title: Museum and Galleries
sections.content: Definition, history and development of the museum. Functions and socio-economic importance of the museum. The administrative structure of the museum. Authenticity and neutrality of the museum. Examples of museums and their activities.
